reason: I like that I can see the actual set and pay on collection, but it's a brand new seller with no reviews and nothing says the refinish won't peel in a few months. £240 is a lot on my money to risk on that.
objection: Refurbished paint can peel or the wheel can fail again, and a 7-day return doesn't cover that. There's no guarantee on the finish and no reviews to show it lasts.
would_change_my_mind: A written guarantee on the finish (say 12 months against peeling or flaking) and a few real reviews or photos of customers' wheels after some months.
